'''Guowei''' is a researcher in [[Huaxu Academy]]. He sorts information in the Archive Room of the academy.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Guowei}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Guowei:''' Wow, a visitor in the archives! This place is usually so boring.
:{{DIcon}} What is the Archive Room?
:'''Guowei:''' In other words, if the Huaxu Academy is like Jinzhou's main library, then the archives are like the library within that library.
:'''Guowei:''' Everything about this academy can be found here. There's nothing about it that I don't know.
:'''Guowei:''' Did you come here with any questions?
:{{DIcon|Arrow}} Tell me more about the Academy.
::'''Guowei:''' You're in luck because I'm here every day sorting out info, so I know the Huaxu Academy inside out.
::'''Guowei:''' Huaxu Academy is Jinzhou's research center, a branch of Huanglong Huaxu Academy, and a respected academic institution.
::'''Guowei:''' Huaxu Academy, the heart of Jinzhou's research, is a branch of the esteemed Huanglong Huaxu Academy, and a respected academic institution.
::'''Guowei:''' There are various departments, including the Department of Anomaly Studies, the Department of Laboratory Evaluation, the Department of Safety, and the Department of Resources. Occasionally, a Special Project Team is also established.
::'''Guowei:''' Every department at Huaxu Academy is at the forefront of research. Pretty impressive, right?
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Let's talk next time.
{{Dialogue End}}
